interpretation: Exploratory conditional association in the completed ESMFold snapshot. Does not propagate topology/rate-estimation uncertainty or demonstrate phylogenetically independent ecology, causal exposure effects, physical movement or selection. Structural predictions derive from sequences; circularity remains. Extant RSA and confidence summaries are not ancestral or phylogenetically weighted. Marker clusters need not be fully independent. No claim that the full lineage-wide objective is complete.
